baseline/selected_rule.methodology: Primary daily counts use horizon 1: one target day per origin. All-horizon counts are distinct forecast cases, not independent days. Actual regional strong fraction uses only observed proxy labels, qualified at >=5% marine support. Predicted fraction uses dense training-supported cells. P75/P90 thresholds are fixed from 2021-2023. Missing target observations are UNKNOWN. Unavailable-input high-risk days remain missed warnings, with abstention counts reported. Hindcast availability is assessed at origin, not using today's age; product delivery latency is unknown.
